title: Dating the Bronze Mannequins road show with Charles Taylor
summary: Allen asks about the Bronze Mannequins; Punch says it was Charles Taylor's show, shortly before World War II when Chicago work slowed.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Well, to get back to the, you're getting there, you were playing with Miramaks, Miramakas? Miramakas. Now who was the Bronze Bannikens? That was the same album?

Well, I started in that, I say, I don't know, the time, things got kind of slow there in Chicago, and I went out on the road with them. See, it must have been around, it wasn't in the 40s, before the 40s.
Was it before World War II?
Or 39 or something like that, huh?
Was it before World War II?
Yeah, a little before that, a little before that.
